collected_via: browser (free web UI, async job API)
caveat: Probability, not verdict. Scores are single runs and vary run to run. 80-word minimum per check.
finding: The five voices are stylistically distinct, but none of the LLM-generated rewrites beat the detector: every rewrite scored 97-99% AI, statistically the same as the raw draft (99%). The one genuinely human-written control scored 3%. Clever is reading the generator's fingerprints, not surface style, so style editing has a ceiling. The base-model/HIP route (regenerate through a non-instruction-tuned model) remains the deeper lever, as documented in evals/clever/ and SKILL.md.
